orgs.name: STXBP1 Foundation
orgs.snippet: Changes in the STXBP1 gene impair communication between neurons, specifically the vesicular release of neurotransmitter along the synapses.

orgs.name: STXBP1 UK Foundation
orgs.snippet: STXBP1 UK Foundation connects and supports families affected by STXBP1-related disorder, and funds the research that's working towards better treatment — and, ultimately, a cure.

orgs.name: Asociación Síndrome STXBP1 (Spain)
orgs.snippet: La encefalopatía STXBP1 es una grave enfermedad neurológica debida a una mutación en el gen STXBP1.

orgs.name: European STXBP1 Consortium (ESCO)
orgs.snippet: The European STXBP1 Consortium (ESCO) is dedicated to advancing the understanding and treatment of STXBP1-related disorders (STXBP1-RD).

orgs.name: Simons Searchlight — STXBP1
orgs.snippet: Simons Searchlight – Help the Simons Searchlight team learn more about STXBP1 genetic changes by taking part in our research.
